notes.title: JEEPNEY SIMULATOR FULL VERSION RELEASE
notes.content:
[h1]END OF THE ROAD[/h1]
First off, we just want to say a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] to all our wonderful fans and supporters. You've been pivotal to Jeepney Simulator and Spacezero Interactive's success. We wouldn't be here without your adoring support over the past few months. You guys are the best <3

As our final gift to you all before we work on another title which we know you guys will love, here is the final version of Jeepney Simulator. We weren't able to add in all of the features we wanted in the game, but rest assured that they'll be in Jeepney Simulator 2. Soon :D

[b]PATCH NOTES[/b]
- Juber (Jeepney Uber) rating system.
- Zoo and Food Alley landmarks.
- More buildings and vehicles!
- New "Hiraya Van".
- New Armored Car.
- New AI Jeepney (rare).
- Mid-click to get all coins in changemat.
- Jeepney customizations such as PH flag, fan, horn,
and family picture!
- Full campaign/story!
- 2 new bosses!
- Bunch of new events!
- Removed "thank you for playing the early access 
version"  on day 6.
- Decreased Willys size
- Make fan spin.
- Bugfixes and more!

notes.title: WEEK 2 UPDATE
notes.content:
[h3]GAME[/h3]
- LONGER SHIFTS: Each hour in Jeepney Simulator now takes 60 seconds compared to the previous 45 seconds. We did this in order for players to have more time exploring the bigger map!
- ATM: Present in Billy's Office, these HAWK brand ATMs allow players to withdraw money from their safe!
- WALLET: A P200 upgrade that allows you to carry 15 items in your hand!
- DESTINATION CARDS: Immerse yourself even further in the jeepney driver lifestyle by customizing your own routes through Dabbo City! But for an extra challenge, every shift will have three random landmarks that you can't reject!
- HEADLIGHTS! Press "R" and let there be light!
- NORTH DABBO CITY UNLOCKED: The NEW Dabbo Airport and Gateway Mall LANDMARKS have finally finished construction and are now ready to take your passengers. There's also ANOTHER GAS STATION near the new bridge along with a few special road types 😃
- More passenger spawnpoints on the map
- Three NEW EVENTS for you guys to find!
- Better drop-off points for Antonio Luna, South Mark, and Twynn Towers
- Get ready to hustle! Jeepney upgrades are now slightly more expensive!
- Still accidentally clicking random buttons? We've now added a confirmation prompt when you press the tutorial
- Stronger braking! PARA PO!
- Added "hold L/R mouse to grab/drop coins quickly" text on alberto's mat

[h3]SETTINGS[/h3]
- Custom keybinds!
- Cleaner settings panel

[h3]BUGFIXES[/h3]
- Fixed bug: coins on hand stay there after pressing tutorial, new game, and load
- Jeepney now stops accelerating when the player exits their seat
- Decreased manycab and tamaraw light intensity
- Fixed bug: completely white female NPC waiting at the sidewalk near midnight

[h3]KNOWN ISSUES[/h3]
- Clicking Bug (Occurs on screens with framerates higher than 60. If it's difficult to click things, we recommend holding L/R to make grabbing and dropping easier)

notes.title: WEEK 1 UPDATE
notes.content:
We just want to say that we're very grateful for all the love and support we've had this past week! We can't believe it's only been a week since we release Jeepney Simulator into this world. It's been a tough week, but we've pulled through.

As a thank you to all you guys, this is the first official update focusing on features instead of bugfixes. We think your jeepney driving experience will be even more fun with this update! Curious? Check out the patch notes 😃

[h2][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2]
[h3]GAME[/h3]
- ROTATING STEERING WHEELS: Widely requested, and we finally did it. It may not seem like it, but it makes driving 10x more fun!
- 2 NEW LANDMARKS! Introducing the Twynn Towers and Regional Sayaw High School!
- IMPROVED OPTIMIZATION: To reduce lag, we improved the map camera. Instead of rendering every building, road, and terrain feature every frame, it now uses a simple photo version of the map (Made in pixel-art style), which improved framerate significantly!
- BETTER TOWING: You're not able to tow your jeepney to Billy's Garage if you ever get REALLY stuck or run out of fuel!
- 2 New events
- 25% faster braking
- moved customization board to garage for easier access

[h3]BUGFIXES[/h3]
- Fixed recurring Mr. Gear Jam when towing jeepney
- Covered house even further to prevent tax evasion!
- Stretched "thank you for playing the early access version" to fit ultrawide screens

[h3]KNOWN ISSUES[/h3]
- The Elusive Clicking Bug (Occurs on screens with framerates higher than 60. If it's difficult to click things, we recommend holding L/R click to make grabbing/dropping easier)
- Some players hear a woman saying "bayad po", etc at night even though there's no NPC in the jeepney

notes.title: DAY 2 PATCH
notes.content:
[b]GAME[/b]
- Improved jump height requirement
- Changed Tamaraw gold color upgrade name to "King of the Road" :)
- Balanced furniture stats. Furniture can't affect bills anymore but are more expensive

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
- Fixed players not being able to run over pedestrians
- Fixed boundaries near Hiraya Grand Mall
- Fixed getting free furniture by buying and loading save
- Fixed "Area" UI on top of the screen not working for ultrawide resolutions
- To alleviate the bug of vehicles disappearing over time, we despawn all vehicles and reset the vehicle count whenever the player sleeps.
- Made sure passengers only go to the right of your jeepney when you drop them off. Hopefully they won't be running into the road anytime soon :(

[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
- Clicking doesn't work sometimes (We recommend holding the L/R mouse button to grab objects)
